newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI STOCKS END SLIGHTLY UP DESPITE PROFIT TAKING.
newsitem.headline: THAI STOCKS END SLIGHTLY UP DESPITE PROFIT TAKING.

text.p: Thai stocks closed slightly up on Wednesday in thin trade after late profit taking which erased most intraday gains, brokers said.
The composite SET index finished just 0.48 points up at 632.73 on sluggish 4.17 billion baht turnover.
"There was selling pressure in some bank and finance shares in the afternoon. Some investors took profit of earlier gains," said a broker at Ekkapat Finance and Securities.
